description: This file defines a custom Jackson message body writer for JSON serialization in Spark's REST API, including configuration for date formatting and JSON output formatting.

classes.name: JacksonMessageWriter
classes.description: A custom JAX-RS MessageBodyWriter that serializes objects to JSON using Jackson, with specific configuration for Spark's REST API.

methods.name: writeValueAsString
methods.description: Overrides the default method to convert an object to a JSON string using Jackson.

methods.name: isWriteable
methods.description: Determines if the given class can be written by this MessageBodyWriter.

methods.name: writeTo
methods.description: Serializes the object to the provided OutputStream as JSON.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the serialized entity, here always -1 indicating unknown.
